about.title: Etna Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription:
Etna is a town of about 737 people in Scott Valley, and when a family here loses someone, the whole community tends to feel it. A wrongful death claim is the civil path California gives surviving relatives to seek compensation after a death caused by another party's negligence — whether it happened in a collision on State Route 3 or Main Street, on a ranch or job site, or under a care provider's watch. The claim runs separately from any criminal case and does not depend on charges being filed.

Etna's public crash record is small. In 2023 the city logged one injury collision, one person hurt, and no traffic deaths. That is worth stating plainly, because it means many wrongful death situations here arise from something other than a local car crash, and each one deserves an honest look at what actually happened.

LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Siskiyou County families with an independent wrongful death attorney who works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You describe your situation once, and we handle the introduction.

whyChoose.title: What an Independent Attorney Can Help You Sort Out

items.title: Who Has the Right to File
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases: a spouse or domestic partner and children come first, and certain dependents or heirs may qualify when there is no surviving spouse or child. An attorney can confirm who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: A Two-Year Clock, Sometimes Shorter
items.desc: The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, but if a government entity is involved — a public road, a county vehicle, a state agency — the window to give notice is far shorter. Getting the timing right early protects the claim.

items.title: The Full Scope of Losses
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. An attorney helps document each of these rather than leaving them to an insurer's estimate.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on Route 3 outside Etna. Does it matter that this is such a small town?
items.answer: The size of Etna doesn't change your rights under California law. What matters is who was at fault and whether the crash involved a private driver, a commercial vehicle, or a public agency responsible for the roadway. An attorney can help identify every responsible party and make sure the correct deadline is applied.

items.question: The other driver was never charged. Can we still bring a wrongful death claim?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death case is a civil action, and it is entirely separate from any criminal prosecution. The civil standard of proof is lower, so a claim can move forward even if the district attorney declined to file charges or a criminal case ended without a conviction.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive, and what will the attorney charge?
items.answer: LawProactive is free. We are not a law firm; we simply connect you with an independent attorney in our network. Attorneys in the network work on contingency, meaning there is no fee unless there is a recovery, and the terms are laid out in a written agreement before any work begins.
